_comment: The measured truth about the physical rig. Everything reads this. All values null until Phase 1 measures them. Bump version and re-measure whenever the rig physically changes: different guitar, exciter moved, amp gain touched.

gain_staging._note: power_amp_gain_setting is a fixed constant once set. Never a variable under test.

loop._note: candidate_frequencies_hz is the ranked jump-destination list from the swept-sine measurement. It seeds the Goertzel bank.

expression_pedal._note: adc_heel/adc_toe are raw 0-1 analogRead values. A 3.3 V-fed pedal tops out near 0.806, not 1.0. Never hard-code the range.

baseline._note: The 'before' recording: the rig feeding back with no regulation. Every later result is compared against it.
